intent: Establish the safety net for the testsAndMisc restructure: a script that inventories every live reference into the repo, and the directory-depth gate written early as a dry run so the flattening work can be sized before any file moves.
scope: meta/scripts/check_directory_depth.sh (new, NOT yet wired into pre-commit)
Non-goal: no archives, extractions or moves in this commit
Non-goal: the depth gate is deliberately not enforced yet - the tree does not conform
changes: report_live_state.sh enumerates systemd units, /etc config and $HOME symlinks that name an absolute path inside the repo; --check exits 1 while any remain, making it the post-move gate.

check_directory_depth.sh enforces a 2-directory cap, modelled on check_file_length.sh (--all/per-file, EXCLUDED_PREFIXES). Exempts third_party/, docs/superpowers/, .github/skills/ by prefix and any lib/ or tests/ path segment, matched as whole segments so libvirt/ and lib.sh are unaffected.
docs/restructure-live-state.md records the baseline inventory (6 systemd units, 2 /etc guard-lib targets, 19 symlinks) plus the depth dry-run sizing.

Exit code 1 with 'live references into /home/kuhy/testsAndMisc remain', which is correct at baseline since nothing has moved yet.

a/b/c.sh=0, a/b/c/d.sh=1, boot_recovery/tests/lib/x.sh=0, focus_policy/tests/test_model.py=0, meta/scripts/lib/trace_stubs.sh=0, meta/scripts/fixtures/mutations/monitor.json=1, third_party+docs/superpowers+.github/skills prefixes=0.
